name: banded-machine-t-bar-row
instructions:
1. Attach a band to the circular weight peg and then add additional plates if desired.
2. Lie prone on the pad of a T-Bar machine and grasp the handle with a neutral or pronated grip depending upon preference or programming.
3. Begin the movement by driving the elbows behind the body while retracting the shoulder blades.
4. Pull the weight towards your body until the elbows are at (or just past) the midline and then slowly lower the weight back to the starting position under control.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
